canonicalFacts.claim: Levothyroxine monotherapy is the standard treatment for hypothyroidism, but 10-15% of patients have persistent symptoms despite normalizing thyroid hormone levels
Treatment-refractory hypothyroidism may require unexpectedly high levothyroxine doses due to impaired absorption or other factors
Myxedema coma is an endocrine emergency with high mortality risk that commonly presents with altered mental status, hypothermia, and depressed vital signs
The lifetime risk of overt hypothyroidism is around 5%, usually preceded by subclinical hypothyroidism with prevalence up to 9%

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Aromatherapy inhalation may help reduce fatigue symptoms in women with hypothyroidism

redFlags: Myxedema coma is an endocrine emergency requiring immediate medical attention
Overtreatment with thyroid hormones can cause adverse cardiovascular effects

excludedAgents.name: L-selenomethionine
excludedAgents.reason: High-dose organic selenium (200 μg daily) showed no significant effect on antithyroid antibody levels in children and adolescents with autoimmune thyroiditis in randomized controlled trial

excludedAgents.name: Vitamin D
excludedAgents.reason: Weekly vitamin D supplementation (20,000 IU) showed no significant effect on muscle function in patients with I131-induced hypothyroidism in pilot randomized trial
